searchText: Hey <@892053833121923094> how are devnet 8 tests coming along? We made a lot of progress on the Engine API and the execution-spec-tests and need to put it all together today The 4788 issue, we are going to workaround it in the tests but I think we need to discuss a proper solution in ACD-E, and we need to pre fund the stateful precompile account in the devnet is that different from the other precompiles that we fund? random example: https://github.com/ethpandaops/4844-testnet/blob/master/network-configs/devnet-7/genesis.json#L234 Ah it's exactly the same 🙂 this should work: https://github.com/ethpandaops/4844-testnet/blob/55895464d4afc52382078341c265df2f3f6ce33b/network-configs/devnet-7/genesis.json#L54 We had to add this to every Cancun test so we don't have issues with the state root not matching, but it seems like it's working and we should be able to fill all tests soon 🙂 Awesome, that should be extremely simple for us to add to the genesis tool in that case. cc <@861807242156572722> in case you wanna update the etb tooling stack. could i bother you for the opcode? afaik we have to fund the opcode with 1 right? It's that exact line I linked, we just need to make sure that it's in the alloc for the devnet, and in our case all tests ``` "0x000000000000000000000000000000000000000b": { "balance": "1" } ``` The problem in our case is that without it, the storage was cleared because the precompile was detected to be an empty account and deleted ahh got it! thanks 😄 i guess we dont need to make any changes then Yep it should work as is right now 🙌 the infinite wisdom of <@&904097637085614120> saves us time years later

excerpts.content: Hey <@892053833121923094> how are devnet 8 tests coming along?

excerpts.author: marioevz
excerpts.content: We made a lot of progress on the Engine API and the execution-spec-tests and need to put it all together today

excerpts.author: marioevz
excerpts.content: The 4788 issue, we are going to workaround it in the tests but I think we need to discuss a proper solution in ACD-E, and we need to pre fund the stateful precompile account in the devnet

excerpts.author: marioevz
excerpts.content: Ah it's exactly the same 🙂 this should work: https://github.com/ethpandaops/4844-testnet/blob/55895464d4afc52382078341c265df2f3f6ce33b/network-configs/devnet-7/genesis.json#L54

excerpts.author: marioevz
excerpts.content: We had to add this to every Cancun test so we don't have issues with the state root not matching, but it seems like it's working and we should be able to fill all tests soon 🙂

excerpts.author: parithosh
excerpts.content: Awesome, that should be extremely simple for us to add to the genesis tool in that case. cc <@861807242156572722> in case you wanna update the etb tooling stack.

excerpts.author: parithosh
excerpts.content: could i bother you for the opcode? afaik we have to fund the opcode with 1 right?

excerpts.author: marioevz

excerpts.author: marioevz
